description: Pushed PDF to reMarkable autonomously without asking David where it should go, and used 'Alice Mburu - 1on1 Call Prep' as the filename (using 'on' instead of a proper separator for the colon, and without confirming naming convention). File landed in /Meetings by assumption.
correction: Should have asked David which reMarkable folder to target before pushing, and confirmed the filename convention (e.g. '1-1' vs '1on1'). File push to reMarkable is an action with user-visible side effects — it requires explicit instruction on destination.
systemic_fix: For reMarkable pushes: always confirm target folder and filename with David before executing. Do not infer destination from folder structure.
